notes: Both articles are unrepresented for different reasons: s005 by rule 20's displacement (the free genitive ἡμῶν supplies our), s008 by rule 31's closing clause, the ASV supplying no relative clause in front of the prepositional phrase πρὸς ὑμᾶς.
εἴσοδον keeps in inside its own unit on rule 106's principle: πρός is separately realized by unto, so no preposition stands to answer to the particle.
